Description: CoopKit Matchmaking: Amazon GameLift Servers FlexMatch in standalone mode for co-op matches of 2-4 players, with a small HTTP backend (Lambda function URL, SNS, DynamoDB). No AWS keys in the game. MIT License. Delete the stack to remove everything it created.

MinPlayers.Description: Fewest players of a match. A match this small is made only after FullMatchWaitSeconds.

MaxPlayers.Description: Most players of a match. FlexMatch first looks for a full match.

FullMatchWaitSeconds.Description: Seconds FlexMatch waits for a full match before it accepts MinPlayers. Must be less than RequestTimeoutSeconds.

RequestTimeoutSeconds.Description: Seconds a ticket may wait before FlexMatch times it out.

DefaultMode.Description: Mode of a player whose ticket has no Mode attribute (letters, digits, hyphens). Only players of the same Mode are matched.

TokenLifetimeSeconds.Description: How long a player's session token from POST /v1/sessions is valid.

ApiReservedConcurrency.Description: Most API requests handled at once, to cap cost under abuse. 0 leaves it unlimited (new accounts cannot reserve concurrency).

RuleSetBody.Fn::Sub: {"name": "coopkit-coop", "ruleLanguageVersion": "1.0", "playerAttributes": [{"name": "Mode", "type": "string", "default": "${DefaultMode}"}], "algorithm": {"strategy": "exhaustiveSearch", "batchingPreference": "random", "expansionAgeSelection": "oldest"}, "teams": [{"name": "coop", "minPlayers": ${MaxPlayers}, "maxPlayers": ${MaxPlayers}}], "rules": [{"name": "SameMode", "description": "Players of one match chose the same mode", "type": "batchDistance", "batchAttribute": "Mode"}], "expansions": [{"target": "teams[coop].minPlayers", "steps": [{"waitTimeSeconds": ${FullMatchWaitSeconds}, "value": ${MinPlayers}}]}]}

Properties.Description: CoopKit Matchmaking: writes FlexMatch ticket events to the ticket table
CoopKit Matchmaking: HTTP API of the FlexMatch backend

ApiUrl.Description: Base Url of the provider in the queue Data Asset (remove the trailing slash).

MatchmakingConfigurationName.Description: FlexMatch matchmaking configuration of this stack.

TicketTableName.Description: DynamoDB table with the tickets (items expire after an hour).
